ratification.note: Number of distinct maintainers who must be listed in ratified_by before an entry or a decision counts. Open question for the owner.

in_scope.statement: New Tapir JSON commands in the Archicad Add-On, each with schemas, a registered description and one example.
in_scope.source: CLAUDE.md: Adding or changing a command

in_scope.statement: Grasshopper components for existing Tapir commands, and Archicad tool components (one per tool) following the ElementToolComponent pattern.
Shared scripts as a new marketplace/<slug>/ folder, adapted by the marketplace README rules.
Support for a new Archicad version once Graphisoft publishes its DevKit (archicad_devkit_update.yml).

out_of_scope.statement: Shared marketplace scripts are never added to builtin-scripts/.

contention.note: Files two pull requests may both edit without competing: shared registries and generated files. Hunks that overlap anywhere else are competing solutions.

additive_split.note: A modified file with more than max_deleted_lines removed lines is a change to existing behaviour. non_behavioral paths are not counted.

contested.note: max_human_comments is the N of the design. All three numbers are open for the owner.
